senses.gloss:
[तुद् भावे घञ्] 
__1 Pain, anguish, torture; ततस्तत्कृततोदोऽपि ततो गोदोऽधिकोऽभवत् [[Śiva B. 14. 89.]] 
__2 The sun. [Page0778-1] 
__3 Guiding, urging, driving (horses &c.). 
__4 Sharp pain. 
__5 Ved. A sacrificer. 
__6 Pressure; पादतोदात् [[Mātaṅga L. 1. 31.]]

[तुद्-करणे घञ्] 
__1 Pain, anguish. 
__2 A goad. 
__3 Face, mouth (तुण्ड).
